generation.limitations: Answer relevance uses normalized phrase matching and citation checks; it is not a general semantic judge.

performance.methodology: Single local deterministic run over synthetic documents using TokenHashEmbeddingProvider and SQLite temporary storage.

frontend_validation.reason: No Playwright, Puppeteer, jsdom, or browser automation dependency is installed in this repository.
validated_by_node_vm_tests: chat fallback and AI citation display
frontend_validation.claim_level: frontend integration tests only; not full browser-level validation

comparison_with_earlier_reports.reason: Phase 3.6 uses a larger new synthetic corpus and SQLite storage, so metric trends are informational only.

known_limits: No live OpenAI-compatible provider calls were made.
No real customer or workspace data was used.
TokenHash embeddings make the run deterministic but are not equivalent to all-MiniLM-L6-v2 quality.
Browser automation is unavailable in this repo, so frontend validation is Node VM integration coverage.
Metrics on synthetic support data are regression evidence, not production proof.
